scope: Additive correction of pass labels in immutable reviews through runs 13 and 15. Their successful run totals included one disabled physical-reference test; this receipt distinguishes reported totals from individual test outcomes. Prior receipts are unchanged.
method: Strict full-line regexes distinguish individual tests from global summaries; each individual outcome is assigned to its active suite and reconciled with both per-suite and global totals. Parameterized argument-start lines are not counted as completed tests.

regexes.testFailed: ^\S+  Test (?!run(?: |$)).+ failed after [0-9.]+ seconds with [0-9]+ issues?\.$
regexes.suiteFailed: ^\S+  Suite (.+) failed after [0-9.]+ seconds with [0-9]+ issues?\.$
regexes.globalSummary: ^\S+  Test run with ([0-9]+) tests? in ([0-9]+) suites? (passed|failed) after ([0-9.]+) seconds(?: with ([0-9]+) issues?)?\.$

qualification: Counting verification only; disabled tests remain unexecuted and this does not change any failed guest or release outcome.
